title: *New* East Nashville Bungalow 2BD/2BA
description:
Step out of real life and into vacation mode. This 2 bed / 2 bath bungalow is nestled in one of the city’s most walkable and sought-after neighborhoods. The perfect mix of quaint residential charm and city buzz — sip coffee on the porch, stroll to restaurants, bars and parks, and soak up the East Side energy.
Whether you’re here for a show, on business, or just want to experience where the locals actually hang, this is your perfect home base.
Book now and settle in — you’re gonna love it here.

The space
Brand new to Airbnb, this cozy bungalow features two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, an open living area that flows into a well-stocked kitchen and dining area, plenty of natural light, comfy beds, and just the right touch of East Nashville charm.

Out back, a covered porch is perfect for slow mornings or happy hour!

Guest access
Whole house & yard, 
no access to  the third bedroom.
